definitions.gloss: visitor; caller; person who comes to visit
definitions.explanation: Used in business, official, and written contexts.

examples.japanese: {来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記帳|きちょう}→記帳：18809_kichou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Visitors, please sign in at the reception desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三十名|さんじゅうめい}でした。

{来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{入館|にゅうかん}⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧し、{退館|たいかん}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返却|へんきゃく}して→返却する：21323_henkyakusuru⟧⟦いただいています→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Visitors are issued an entry card, which they return upon leaving.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{来訪|らいほう}→来訪：13120_raihou⟧ (visit, calling) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). A formal word for a visitor, particularly one who comes to an office, institution, or other official setting. More formal than ⟦{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}→訪問者：20148_houmonsha⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to receive a visitor
- {来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: visitor log
- {来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧: visitor parking
- {来訪|らいほう}{者|しゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: handling visitors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}→訪問者：20148_houmonsha⟧: visitor (slightly less formal, more general)
- ⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧: guest, customer (honorific, broader usage)
- ⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧: visitor, guest (commonly used for home or office visitors)
- ⟦{参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}→参拝者：21620_sanpaisha⟧: shrine or temple visitor (religious context)
